pkgmetadata.longdescription: Trafilatura is a Python library and command-line tool for web crawling, scraping, and text extraction from HTML pages. It focuses on extracting the main body text and metadata from web pages while removing boilerplate, and can output in various formats including plain text, CSV, JSON, HTML, Markdown, and TEI-XML.

use.flag: Use pycurl as an alternative HTTP backend
